description: Unified prompt contract for decoupled, multi-layered virtual try-on, UGC/editorial scene switching, beauty adjustments, and accessory styling onto canonical influencer base plates with 0.0000% character and unmasked drift.
role_and_system_directive: You are an elite virtual try-on fashion technical director. Your objective is to modify or synthesize the targeted atomic layer while preserving all unmasked layers (facial identity, expression, skin tone, hair anatomy, environment, or adjacent accessories) with mathematical 0.0000% drift.

decoupled_layer_hierarchy.LAYER_0_SPATIAL_FRAMING: Aspect ratio (9:16 / 4:5 / 1:1), camera angle, focal length (85mm / 50mm), turnaround angle (Front 0° / 3/4 45° / Profile 90° / Back 180°)
decoupled_layer_hierarchy.LAYER_1_ENVIRONMENT_SCENE: Interchangeable scene context (Editorial Studio shoot vs Authentic UGC lifestyle), dynamic lighting setup, and color palette calibrated to garment craftsmanship
decoupled_layer_hierarchy.LAYER_2_SUBJECT_BASE_CANVAS: Locked human anatomical foundation in bare-minimum neutral slip/bodysuit (zero accessories, naked neck/ears/wrists/waist) allowing any garment cut
decoupled_layer_hierarchy.LAYER_3_BEAUTY_COSMETICS: Cosmetic grooming adjustments: eye contact lenses, hair dye color/styling, makeup palette (eyeliner, eyeshadow, lips, skin glow)

LAYER_4_GARMENT_BRICKS.BRICK_4A: Base Garment (bodice, sleeves, kali skirt, back cutout; editable colors, prints, zari)
LAYER_4_GARMENT_BRICKS.BRICK_4B: Draping Layer (asymmetric cowl pallu, dupatta, trailing cape, shoulder sash)
LAYER_4_GARMENT_BRICKS.BRICK_4C: Structural Cinch (embroidered waist belt / kamarbandh / corset band)

LAYER_5_FINE_JEWELRY.BRICK_5A: Neckwear (Polki choker, emerald collar, delicate chain, or bare skin)
LAYER_5_FINE_JEWELRY.BRICK_5B: Earwear (Antique gold jhumkas, chandelier drops, pearl studs, or bare lobes)
LAYER_5_FINE_JEWELRY.BRICK_5C: Head/Hair Jewelry (Maang tikka, matha patti, embellished hair pins)

LAYER_6_ACCESSORIES_STYLING.BRICK_6A: Handwear (Gold bangles, kadas, luxury watch, cocktail rings)
LAYER_6_ACCESSORIES_STYLING.BRICK_6B: Handhelds (Embellished bridal potli, metallic clutch, leather bag)
LAYER_6_ACCESSORIES_STYLING.BRICK_6C: Footwear (Zari embroidered mojris, block-heel sandals, stilettos)

decoupled_layer_hierarchy.LAYER_7_HARMONIZATION: Physical integration pass: contact shadows, ambient occlusion, bounce light radiosity, optical depth of field

base_input_plate.description: Base input plate containing current assembled state.

active_layer_reference.description: Reference asset for the active layer being synthesized or edited (garment piece, jewelry item, accessory, or scene reference).

active_layer_mask.description: Binary inpainting mask targeting strictly the active layer boundary while locking all other pixels.

prompt_template.system_prefix: Modify ONLY the white masked area corresponding to {{TARGET_LAYER_ID}}. Keep all unmasked regions (face, skin, hair, background, or other layers) bit-for-bit identical.
prompt_template.character_and_environment_lock: Preserve the exact same woman, facial bone structure, warm olive skin tone with natural pores, eye expression, hair bun/parting, and environment. Unmasked pixels must remain 100% frozen.
prompt_template.active_layer_transfer_directive: Synthesize or edit the active layer faithfully: {{LAYER_SPECIFICATIONS}}
prompt_template.realism_and_boundary_directives: Flawless physical boundary blending, authentic micro-textures (sheer georgette, metallic zari threads, polished gemstones, skin sheen), realistic light falloff, zero seam artifacts, luxury fashion catalog standard.
prompt_template.negative_constraints: identity drift, facial morphing, altered skin tone, hair unraveling, unmasked pixel alteration, mask seamline halos, plastic skin, CGI, distorted anatomy, duplicate drapes, floating accessories, watermark, text.

LAYER_SPECIFICATIONS.example: Pre-draped cowl dupatta in sheer imperial wine maroon faux georgette. Pleated sash anchored securely onto the wearer's left shoulder, flowing diagonally across the chest into soft, fluid crescent cowl swags across the wearer's right hip. Scalloped antique gold threadwork along the outer border with micro-pearl bead fringe droplets.

three_ws_guidelines.what_to_enforce: Fully decoupled layer separation. Every layer (scene, model base, cosmetics, dress bricks, jewelry, accessories) can be edited or swapped independently without affecting other layers.
three_ws_guidelines.when_to_apply: Applied during all virtual try-ons, editorial vs UGC transitions, colorway variations, beauty adjustments, and accessory styling passes.
three_ws_guidelines.why_and_remediation: Monolithic generation causes context entanglement and destroys cross-catalog brand consistency. Decoupled layer inpainting via FLUX.1 Fill guarantees mathematical 0.0000% unmasked drift.

execution_binding.inpaint_engine: FLUX.1 Fill [dev] via ComfyUI (surgical layer synthesis)
execution_binding.outpaint_relight_engine: FLUX Fill + IC-Light (UGC/Editorial scene swap and lighting harmonization)
execution_binding.semantic_vision_engine: Gemini Nano Banana (turnaround sheets, detail macro sheets, Vision QA)
